annotation.walkthrough: 'Great metropolis' is two pieces: A1, written with the letter I, then CITY. The UK Atomic Energy Authority runs nuclear research at Culham in Oxfordshire.
annotation.definitionFit: The UK Atomic Energy Authority is the British body that carries out nuclear research, and its sites are research centres.
